scope: Small isolated headless Chrome loopback HTTP/1.1 request-body capability probe; not an application, MCP or memory benchmark
method: A temporary local HTTP server served a page and counted request bytes. The page posted four bytes as a normal string, then attempted the same request as a ReadableStream with duplex half.
result: The ordinary POST returned byte count 4; the stream POST rejected with TypeError: Failed to fetch. No application code was changed. This observation does not determine the precise browser failure cause or the behavior of other protocols and browsers.
driverNote: The probe was run from the integration checkout's tests directory so its Playwright import resolved; its source was then copied to the evidence directory and the temporary checkout file was removed.
interpretation: The present loopback HTTP/1.1 setup cannot use this specific streaming fetch as a drop-in response-body replacement in this test. The large-project resource issue remains unresolved.
